name: Tongxi Wang
institution: School of Future Technology, Southeast University
institutionZh: 东南大学未来技术学院
tagline: I study the dynamics, stability, and efficiency of learning systems.
taglineZh: 研究强化学习理论、训练动力学、上下文学习与可靠人工智能系统。
intro: I am an undergraduate researcher at Southeast University, working across reinforcement learning, multi-agent learning, and efficient language models. I care about mathematical structure that clarifies how learning systems behave and improves how they work in practice.
introZh: 关注能够被清晰解释、严格验证，并最终落到真实系统中的理论。
